details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:236-246 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `inject_identity_recall_block` writes temporary `.identity.*` files into the tracked `prompts/` directory instead of a temp directory.
  WHY: Those generated artifacts accumulate in the repo tree and can be committed as part of the render workflow.
- .gitignore:(added at end, after existing patterns) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Generated temporary identity/assembled files created under `prompts/` are not being ignored and end up committed to the repository tree.
  WHY: Without an ignore rule, `mktemp` artifacts pollute git history and create merge-noise on every render run.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:22-39,1220-1229 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The PR removes `emit_event` sourcing/fallback and the `AUTOFIX_PEER_CHECK` event-mirroring call.
  WHY: This regresses the event telemetry path for `.events/*.jsonl`; reviewers disagreed on severity as blocker vs major, so the merged severity is critical.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:84-91,154-172 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The PR removes `_mirror_event` and its `emit_event` import, dropping Semble telemetry mirroring.
  WHY: Semble query/fallback events are no longer mirrored to `.events/*.jsonl`; reviewers disagreed on severity as blocker vs major, so the merged severity is critical.
- scripts/semble_helpers.sh:1-35,20-29 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The PR removes `emit_event` sourcing and the `emit_event` call from `_semble_log_event`.
  WHY: Semble event mirroring is severed, so `SEMBLE_QUERY` and `SEMBLE_FALLBACK` logs only hit stderr.
- scripts/serena_stats_emit.py:11-18,26-34,131-147 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The PR removes `_mirror_event` and its `emit_event` import from the Serena stats emit path.
  WHY: `SERENA_QUERY` events that were mirrored to `.events/*.jsonl` are silently lost.
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:10-22,83-100 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The PR removes `_mirror_event` from the MCP handshake probe path.
  WHY: `SERENA_PROBE` events are no longer mirrored to `.events/*.jsonl`.
- scripts/setup_serena.sh:22-31,42-69 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The PR removes `emit_event` sourcing and the `SERENA_FALLBACK` event-mirroring calls from the Serena setup path.
  WHY: `SERENA_FALLBACK` events stop being mirrored to `.events/*.jsonl`.
- prompts/_templates/mode-plan.txt:19-25 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The PR adds a `4a. ## Decisions` requirement to the plan prompt template, changing the plan-output contract.
  WHY: This is out of scope for Phase B and can break downstream plan parsing/validation; reviewers disagreed on severity as blocker vs major, so the merged severity is critical.
- .ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt:310-316 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The workspace-reuse manifest is manually edited to add `emit_event` scripts and tests.
  WHY: This generated manifest should be regenerated by CI; manual edits create drift between the manifest and the actual source tree.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]

- requirement: "Revert manual edit of .ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt"
  expected_change_site: .ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt should be generated by CI only
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  EVIDENCE: The diff shows manual additions for `scripts/emit_event.py`, `scripts/emit_event.sh`, and test files.
